task.title: Work with Large Files (Git LFS)
task.shortdesc: The Git Client detects and handles files tracked with Git Large File Storage.

step.cmd: Install Git LFS by following the instructions at git-lfs.com.

result.p: Once Git LFS is installed and files are tracked, the Git Client detects and handles them automatically.
result.note: If you connect through a proxy, LFS operations need the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable set. See .
